description: Exergy efficiency model with flash pressure optimization (single/double flash)

unit.name: Generic Single-Flash Geothermal Plant
unit.source: DiPippo, R. (2015). Geothermal Power Plants, 4th ed. Butterworth-Heinemann. Chapter 5-6.

T_flash_design.note: Flash separator temperature; optimized to ~0.63*T_geo for single flash

eta_utilization.note: Utilization efficiency accounts for non-equilibrium flash, separator losses, turbine irreversibilities

steam_quality_factor.note: Approx steam fraction from single flash at design point
